title: Baobab IAM Organisation Projection Contracts (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-10)
description:
Definition library for the link between a canonical Organisation and its IAM-native projections (Keycloak Organization), and for the IAM organisation evidence the Control Plane resolves.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/IamOrganisationReference), not the document root.

Keycloak Organization is an IAM projection, never the canonical Organisation (ADR-BCP-018 sections 64, 97 and 180). A canonical Organisation MAY have several IAM representations, for example one per realm, environment or region (section 65); one provider organisation within one issuer maps to exactly one canonical Organisation. An IAM organisation claim is context evidence, not truth (section 66): the Control Plane resolves it through an active IamOrganisationReference to a canonical Organisation and then validates that Organisation against the tenant; it never copies the claim into trusted context.

iamProvider.description: IAM product whose native organisation the reference points to. Adding a provider is a contract change; provider IDs never replace canonical Organisation identity.

iamIssuer.description: Token issuer that scopes the provider organisation ID: for Keycloak, the realm issuer URL (https://<host>/realms/<realm>). The same provider organisation ID under two issuers names two different IAM organisations.

providerOrganisationId.description: The provider's own immutable organisation identifier (for Keycloak, the Organization id, not its alias or name).

iamReferenceStatus.description: Only an ACTIVE reference inside its effective window resolves. A RETIRED reference is kept for history and never resolves.

IamOrganisationReference.description: Explicit link from one canonical Organisation to one IAM-native organisation. Creating or retiring it never changes the canonical Organisation, its tenants or its relationships.

source_authority.description: Who established the link (e.g. control-plane-admission, iam-reconciliation). Never the applicant.

IamOrganisationEvidence.description: IAM organisation evidence a workload presents instead of a canonical organisation_id, taken from its authenticated user's organisation claim. The Control Plane resolves it through an ACTIVE IamOrganisationReference and then attests the resulting Organisation against the tenant exactly as for an organisation_id; unresolvable evidence fails closed.

keycloakOrganizationClaim.description: Keycloak's `organization` token claim in the form Baobab relies on: the Organization Membership mapper with the organisation id included, keyed by organisation alias. Only the id is evidence; aliases are mutable display handles and are never resolved. The alias-only list form (`["acme"]`) is not resolvable, and a claim naming several organisations resolves only when the caller selects exactly one of them.

IamOrganisationLinkRequest.description: Links a canonical Organisation to its IAM-native projection (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-10). The Organisation comes from the path and the source authority from the Control Plane. Repeating an existing link returns it; a link held by another Organisation is refused.

IamOrganisationRetireRequest.description: Retires a link. A RETIRED link never resolves.

reason.description: Why, recorded in the audit trail.

IamOrganisationResolution.description: The canonical Organisation that IAM evidence resolves to now, through an ACTIVE link in effect.
